description: The bar chart, titled "effect" and sourced from the paper "Morphosyntactic probing of multilingual BERT models," displays the performance of various BERT models across different language families. The horizontal axis categorizes languages into nine groups: IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic. The vertical axis represents the effect size, ranging from -5 to 35, with a linear scale. For each language family, multiple bars are shown, representing different BERT models: mBERT-L₂ (light blue), XLM-L₂ (dark blue), mBERT-R₂ (light green), XLM-R₂ (dark green), mBERT-B₂ (light red), and XLM-B₂ (dark red). Each bar has an error bar indicating the standard deviation or confidence interval. The chart shows that the effect sizes vary significantly between language families and models. For example, in the IE-Indic family, the mBERT-R₂ and XLM-R₂ models show the highest effect sizes, exceeding 20, while in the Uralic family, all models show very low effect sizes, close to zero. The mBERT-L₂ and XLM-L₂ models generally show lower effect sizes compared to their respective R₂ and B₂ counterparts in most language families. The chart also includes a legend in the upper right corner that clearly identifies each model by its color and label.
